picks.headline: Indie Devs Show Why Art Direction Still Matters In DLSS 5 Era
picks.rationale: The one DLSS 5 card of the day, chosen for the art-direction angle no previously published DLSS story covered (perf hit, mods, KCD, No Man's Sky, NBA hands-on).

picks.headline: 'There is absolutely no generative AI in Space Marine 3' promises Saber Interactive executive
picks.excerpt: Saber's chief creative officer draws a hard line on generative AI in Space Marine 3 days after the studio's AI-writer controversy.
picks.rationale: The single strongest card from the Saber cluster: a concrete production commitment on a named title rather than comms-strategy or exec-opinion rehash.

picks.headline: Inside Tencent's long-term strategy: live service, AI tools, and evergreen titles
picks.excerpt: "I think people should just not be afraid of AI"
picks.rationale: How the largest publisher actually slots AI tooling into live-service and evergreen production — pipeline substance, and the stronger of the two Tencent items in the pool.

picks.headline: DoubleDown Interactive's Faith Price on D2C growth, ageing apps and the real cost of AI
picks.excerpt: DoubleDown Interactive's Faith Price on where AI actually pays off in live-ops production - and where its real cost lands.
picks.rationale: Names where AI actually pays for itself in live-ops production and where the hidden cost lands — directly usable by teams planning AI spend.

picks.headline: Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney Says The Industry Is Crashing And AI Is Making It Worse
picks.excerpt: Usually playing the cheerleader for artificial intelligence, the Epic CEO seems to have cooled on the trend and regrets humoring NFTs
picks.rationale: The Unreal Engine owner publicly reversing his AI enthusiasm is a signal for every studio building on his toolchain; adds a fifth distinct outlet.
